purpose: Battle evaluation of the fixed 4096-decision D candidate against the adopted model. Pre-registered before any game. No intermediate checkpoint is evaluated or selected; no adoption, no training, no resident operation.

opponent.note: byte-identical copy of the adopted pair in the production v2 root

adapters: placement v2 (3e962410...) and the same position adapter for BOTH players, from the arm snapshot whose policy code is identical to the production v2 snapshot
criterion: existing promotion_ok: all requested games verified, abnormal_total 0, no rerun/exclusion flag, and the seed-pair (conservative Clopper-Pearson) 95% CI lower bound > 0.5. Operational gate; not a guarantee over repeated comparisons.
